stories.title: How to Play
stories.desc1: Welcome to Nottingham, Merchants! Your ultimate goal is to amass the largest fortune in gold by the end of the game. You'll earn wealth by selling legal goods in the public market... or by smuggling lucrative contraband past the ever-watchful Sheriff!
stories.desc2: Each round, one player takes on the prestigious, iron-fisted role of the Sheriff, while all other players act as cunning Merchants. Merchants draw cards to their hand, then decide which goods they want to try and sneak into the market this turn.
stories.desc3: Now, choose 1 to 5 goods cards from your hand and secretly place them into your felt merchant pouch. Snap the bag shut tight! Make sure no one, especially not the Sheriff, sees what you've packed. Will you play it safe, or take a wild gamble?
stories.desc4: Look the Sheriff straight in the eyes and declare what's inside. You MUST state the exact, correct number of cards you packed, and you MUST declare them as legal goods (Apples, Cheese, Bread, or Chickens). You can lie about the types, but never the quantity!
stories.desc5: This is where the real fun begins! The Sheriff will threaten to inspect your bag. To avoid this, you can offer bribes: cold gold coins, legal goods, smuggled contraband, or even future promises! Negotiate, plead, or slide some gold to make them look the other way.
stories.desc6: If the Sheriff lets you pass, put your goods in your market (bluffs remain secret!). If they inspect and you were honest, the Sheriff must pay you gold for wasting your time. But if you lied and get caught, you pay a heavy gold penalty, and the contraband is confiscated!
stories.desc7: Contraband (Pepper, Silk, Mead) gives massive scores but carries extreme penalties if caught. You can also smuggle Royal Goods (marked with gold stars), which count as multiple standard goods to help you dominate the final King and Queen bonuses!
stories.desc8: Once everyone has played the Sheriff twice, the market closes! Add up your Gold + standard goods value + contraband value. Finally, award the massive King and Queen bonuses to the players with the most Apples, Cheese, Bread, and Chickens. The wealthiest merchant wins!
